column1: Cost of new generation against running existing gas
Real 2025 USD/MWh unless stated (annual-average market FX, Fed H.10; deflated with US CPI-U). Excludes VAT.

2023–24 vintages, converted at annual-average FX. Grey band = 2025 short-run marginal cost of existing gas plant in the UK and Germany (fuel plus carbon, 46–55% efficiency; method as in section 6): a technology whose full levelised cost sits below the band undercuts the running cost of gas already built. CN nuclear = range from $72 (IEA) to $85 (OECD/NEA 2020 at a common 7% cost of capital). UK nuclear = Hinkley Point C contracted price (£128.94/MWh, 2025 prices), not an LCOE. DE nuclear new build ($151–544, excl. back-end costs) runs off the axis; DE restart from an advocacy-adjacent source, against an independent NEA life-extension benchmark of $29–41. CCGT = combined-cycle gas turbine; PV = photovoltaic. Sources. DESNZ Generation Costs 2023 (UK); Fraunhofer ISE 2024 (DE); IEA WEO 2025 (CN); NAO 2026; Radiant Energy Group 2026; OECD/NEA 2020.
